_note: Account identifiers refer to the synthetic seeded graph (ACC_* ordinary accounts, RING_* a planted cash-out ring). No real accounts, people or institutions are involved.

examples.title: Routine domestic payment
examples.blurb: ACC_0336 has paid ACC_0002 before, the amount sits near its usual size, same country, low-risk channel. Nothing in the graph objects.

examples.title: Sudden spike to a new counterparty
examples.blurb: Same sender as above — but 68x its typical amount, by wire, abroad, to an account it has never paid. The signal is amount_z and is_new_pair, and neither exists without transaction history.

examples.title: Transfer inside the cash-out ring
examples.blurb: Both parties sit in the planted ring, so the graph already holds a reverse edge and shared counterparties between them. That structure is invisible to any per-transaction rule.
